# Audio Files

Place your actual audio files here. The manifest expects the following files:

- creepy-whisper.mp3
- door-creak.mp3
- footsteps.mp3
- screech.mp3
- thunder.mp3
- laugh.mp3
- breathing.mp3
- growl.mp3

You can use royalty-free sound effects or record your own. Make sure the files exist before testing audio playback.

The application will not generate fake playback success if files are missing.
